description: Wisconsin Statewide Parcel Map Initiative (V12, State Cartographer's Office / DOA Wisconsin Land Information Program) for the FactLot Registry collector. Covers all 72 counties (130 pages; Milwaukee, FIPS 55079, first). See docs/registry/sources/wi-statewide-parcels.md.

sources.publisher: Wisconsin State Cartographer's Office and Department of Administration, Wisconsin Land Information Program (Statewide Parcel Map Initiative, V12)
sources.license: No formal licence. The data page says 'This data is provided free of charge'; the ArcGIS item's licenseInfo says 'This data free for public consumption as of: 06/30/2026'. Statewide aggregation of county land-information data under 2013 Wisconsin Act 20. The data-access modal disclaims accuracy and warranty only. A feedback form is requested, not required
sources.redistribution: No restriction stated; free for public consumption. Attribution requested by courtesy: Wisconsin State Cartographer's Office / Department of Administration, Wisconsin Land Information Program (V12 Statewide Parcel Map Database Project)
sources.notes: V12 (released 2026-06-30; 3,574,646 parcels; next release V13 tentatively 2027-06-30). Full statewide file geodatabase is 515,810,191 bytes compressed (web.s3.wisc.edu, Last-Modified 2026-06-30) and needs GDAL/ArcGIS, so the config archives JSON pages from the public ArcGIS REST feature service (maxRecordCount 2000, ordered by OBJECTID) filtered to PROPCLASS containing 2 (commercial) or 3 (manufacturing): this config lists 130 pages for all 72 counties: the 9 pages for CONAME='MILWAUKEE' (16,582 parcels; 280,676 in the county) first, then, from the statewide extension of 2026-11-03, the other 71 counties alphabetically by CONAME, ceil(count/2000) pages each (121 pages; per-county counts from the service's own group-by statistics). Statewide 185,994 commercial or manufacturing rows, 185,754 distinct parcels. The page list fits V12 as published; regenerate it from the counts when V13 is released. CONAME (the county the parcel is part of) differs from PARCELFIPS (the contributing county) for Appleton and Menasha parcels in Calumet and Winnebago; the adapter takes the county from CONAME. Owner names are present except Kenosha County (100% redacted, 'NOT AVAILABLE') and partial redaction in 8 counties (Dane 11.43%). Wisconsin has no multifamily property class: apartments are class 2 (commercial). robots.txt: sco.wisc.edu allows all but /wp-admin/; web.s3.wisc.edu has none (NoSuchBucket 404); the ArcGIS Online services host publishes none.
